commands.command:
mkdir -p /root/ansible-repair && cat > /root/ansible-repair/inventory.ini <<'EOF'
[local]
localhost ansible_connection=local
EOF
cat > /root/ansible-repair/repair-permissions.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Repair /srv/inventory ownership and permissions
  hosts: local
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure inventory-readers group exists
      group:
        name: inventory-readers
        state: present

    - name: Ensure inventorysvc user exists
      user:
        name: inventorysvc
        group: inventory-readers
        system: true
        create_home: false
        shell: /sbin/nologin

    - name: Set ownership of /srv/inventory recursively
      file:
        path: /srv/inventory
        owner: inventorysvc
        group: inventory-readers
        recurse: true

    - name: Set directory permissions (rwx owner, rx group, none other)
      shell: |
        find /srv/inventory -type d -exec chmod 0750 {} \;
      changed_when: true

    - name: Set file permissions (rw owner, r group, none other)
      shell: |
        find /srv/inventory -type f -exec chmod 0640 {} \;
      changed_when: true
EOF
echo written
commands.stdout: written
